command_to_feeling.rule: Resolve the command-to-feeling relation from the current runtime array; do not hard-code a permanent training-type mapping.

gauge_gained_flag.summary_meaning: whether gauge acquisition has occurred for the current result

strict_training_sample.interpretation: The +2 on the command-linked feeling is strongly supported for this sample, but is not asserted as a universal formula.

planner_constraints: Use command_feelings from the same runtime snapshot when assigning a command vector to a feeling type.
Use the final per-command vector rather than reconstructing it from an unverified base, partner, region, camp, or deck formula.
At shared inventory capacity, model FIFO replacement instead of suppressing a completed gauge reward.
Do not reuse heroes_gauge or any other scenario's threshold, mapping, or reset behavior.
unknowns: The general decomposition of natural growth, training-linked growth, region, summer camp, scenario-partner, and support-card modifiers is not yet proven.
Race gauge vectors and their dependence on race result are not yet measured.
The exact ordering of ramen consumption, gauge progress, completed-item insertion, and other same-turn events requires paired before/after runtime snapshots.

evidence.claim: Threshold 7, reset without carry, shared 10-slot FIFO overflow, and final command vectors.
Scenario 14 DataSet arrays and fields listed in runtime_protocol.
Bounded acquisition_gauges and command_feelings exposure without walking TrainingFeelingEntity._gaugeGainCountDict or calling GetGainCount.
